description: The agent reads the classic workflow guide and builds a real-time workflow with process_apply: on create of an account, a condition and a created task. The same spec works on both deployment types.
prompt: On the Dyno connection "{connection}", in the solution PowerToolsEvals, create a real-time classic workflow Eval Account Phone Check on account that starts when an account is created and, if the account has no main phone, creates a task 'Ask for a phone number' regarding the account. Activate it.

checks.description: the workflow exists and is activated
its first step is the condition
